title: 'GTA 6' Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1s Releasing Soon
text:
'GTA 6' Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1s Releasing Soon Search sneakers, brands, or styles... Sign In SHOP COMMUNITY STYLE SNEAKERS MUSIC SPORTS POP CULTURE BETS COVER STORIES VERZUZ WATCH COMPLEXCON Sneakers 'GTA 6' Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1s Releasing Soon
 The 'GTA 6' Cactus Jack x Rockstar x Nike Air Force 1s are slated to debut in November.
 By Victor Deng October 31, 2026 Comments Comment Save Share Travis Scott Post, shop, and read Visit community Comments Comments A Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 collection is releasing soon. Via Nike Rockstar Games is planning to release a collection of Nike Air Force 1s with Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack brand this holiday season to coincide with the release of its much-anticipated game, Grand Theft Auto VI . News of the collab was first reported by @Sneakermarkertro on Instagram.
 According to the leaks, the ‘GTA VI’ Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 Lows will be available in three colorways and will hit retail starting in November. At the time of writing, images of the upcoming project have yet to hit the web and the image above is merely a placeholder. Cactus Jack’s involvement with the project makes sense, as Travis is also part of the soundtrack for GTA VI.
 The ‘GTA VI’ Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 collection is slated to release starting on Nov. 19. Check back soon for new developments and official confirmation from the collaborators in the coming weeks.
